import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        employee_id=pl.col("Emp #").str.to_uppercase(),
        employee_name=pl.col("Staff Name"),
        work_date=pl.col("Shift Date").str.to_date("%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
        project_code=pl.col("Job Code").str.to_uppercase(),
        hours_normal=pl.col("Ordinary")
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        hours_overtime=pl.col("OT").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
    )
